tickets.title: Fix missing async init guards causing double-init races in 3 services
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. UnifiedRecipeService.initialize() â€” no _isInitializing guard
`lib/services/unified/unified_recipe_service.dart:442â€“530`

Only checks `_isInitialized` (completed state), not in-progress. Two callers (bootstrap + auth-state-change) can both enter the body simultaneously. Both call `_recipes.clear()`, both set up `_authSubscription` (first leaks), both start `_cacheModule.startFirebaseSync()`. Result: duplicate stream subscriptions, transient blank recipe lists, notifyListeners storm.

Correct pattern exists at `SharedContentCoordinatorViewModel:209`: `if (_isInitialized || _isInitializing) return;`

### 2. FriendsStateManager.initialize() â€” same missing guard
`lib/services/unified/friends/friends_state_manager.dart:63â€“97`

Both FriendsViewModel constructor and re-auth events can call initialize() simultaneously. Both pass `_isInitialized == false`, both call `Future.wait([_loadFriends...])`, both call `_setupRealtimeListeners()` which cancels and re-creates subscriptions â€” but the first call's subscriptions get cancelled before delivering data.

### 3. FriendsProfileCacheManager.loadUserProfilesForRequests() â€” duplicate requests
`lib/viewmodels/friends/friends_profile_cache_manager.dart:27â€“82`

`_isLoadingUserProfiles` is a UI flag, not a re-entrancy guard. Two concurrent calls both compute the same uncached user IDs, make duplicate Firestore reads.

## Why It Matters
Double-init causes leaked stream subscriptions, duplicate Firestore listeners, transient blank states on app start.

## Suggested Fix
1-2. Add `bool _isInitializing = false` guard matching SharedContentCoordinatorViewModel pattern
3. Add `if (_isLoadingUserProfiles) return` re-entrancy guard

tickets.title: Fix stale closures and uncancellable retries causing silent data loss (5 locations)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. PersonalRecipeModule sync retry captures stale recipe â€” DATA LOSS
`lib/services/unified/modules/personal_recipe_module.dart:724â€“807`

Retry closure captures the `recipe` object from the original failed call, not the current version in `_recipes`. If the user edits between failed sync and retry (at 5s, 10s, 20s intervals), retry overwrites the newer version in Firestore.

### 2. SocialOperationsInitializer.scheduleRetry() â€” unbounded recursive retry
`lib/services/unified/helpers/social_operations_initializer.dart:98â€“113`

No max retry count, no cancellation token. `delay.inSeconds * 2` with sub-1s initial delay produces tight loop.

### 3. RetaggingScheduler â€” _isRetagging is not an async lock
`lib/services/tagging/retagging_scheduler.dart:57â€“95`

Periodic timer + scheduled call both enter `_performRetagging()`, causing duplicate `_saveRecipe()`. Also `Future.delayed(5s)` survives dispose().

### 4. FriendsViewModel stale closure in Future.delayed
`lib/viewmodels/friends_viewmodel.dart:399â€“408`

Callback fires between `_isDisposed = true` and `super.dispose()` â€” assertion errors during logout.

## Why It Matters
Finding 1 causes silent data loss. Findings 2-3 cause unbounded retries or duplicate writes.

## Suggested Fix
1. Re-read recipe from `_recipes[recipe.id]` at retry time
2. Add max retry count, store Timer reference for cancellation
3. Use Completer-based lock; cancel Future.delayed in dispose
4. Check _isDisposed after super.dispose()

tickets.title: Fix cache counter drift, presence stream deadlock, and search term mixing (3 concurrency bugs)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. IntelligentCacheManager â€” memory counter drift â†’ unbounded growth
`lib/services/performance/intelligent_cache_manager.dart:257â€“294, 460â€“471`

Two Timer.periodic callbacks and clearCache() concurrently mutate `_currentMemoryUsage`. clearCache() sets counter to 0 while prefetch is mid-await. After await resumes, `_cacheRecipe` adds `+= size` on zeroed counter. Counter drifts, `_ensureMemoryAvailable()` never evicts â†’ OOM.

### 2. PresenceService â€” asyncMap + inner await for deadlocks
`lib/services/presence_service.dart:391â€“409`

`asyncMap` on broadcast stream with inner `await for (... in streams[i].take(1))`. If streams[i] doesn't emit, await for hangs indefinitely, stalling all presence updates. 3+ participant scenario triggers it.

### 3. SharedContentSearchViewModel â€” stale _searchQuery across sequential awaits
`lib/viewmodels/shared_content/shared_content_search_viewmodel.dart:295â€“370`

`_searchQuery` is a field, not local copy. Between three sequential `await _searchContent(...)` calls, a keystroke changes it. Recipe results from "piz" mixed with menu results from "pizza".

## Why It Matters
Finding 1 causes OOM. Finding 2 causes stale presence. Finding 3 causes incorrect search results.

## Suggested Fix
1. Snapshot `_currentMemoryUsage` or use Completer-based lock
2. Replace `asyncMap` + `await for` with `Rx.combineLatest`
3. Snapshot `final query = _searchQuery` at method start; cancel in-flight search on new query

tickets.title: Fix Cloud Functions auth gaps: 4 missing admin checks, rate limit key mismatch, imageUrl SSRF, LLM cost abuse (9 issues)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. Missing admin authorization (4 functions)
`functions/src/admin/` â€” `cleanupOrphanedData`, `migrateUserData`, `forceReindex`, `bulkDeleteUsers` check `auth.uid` exists but never verify admin role/claim. Any authenticated user can call them.

### 2. Rate limiter key mismatch
`functions/src/middleware/rateLimiter.ts` â€” key uses `req.ip` but behind Cloud Run proxy, `req.ip` is always the proxy IP. All users share one rate limit bucket.

### 3. imageUrl SSRF in recipe import
`functions/src/import/processRecipeImport.ts` â€” accepts user-supplied `imageUrl`, fetches it server-side with no URL validation. Can probe internal GCP metadata endpoint (`169.254.169.254`).

### 4. LLM API cost abuse
`functions/src/ai/generateTags.ts` â€” no per-user daily quota. Single user can trigger unlimited OpenAI API calls.

### 5-9. Input validation gaps
Missing field length limits on recipe title (can store 1MB string), missing Content-Type validation, no request body size limit on 3 endpoints.

## Why It Matters
Admin functions callable by any user = full data wipe possible. SSRF = GCP credential theft. No LLM quota = unbounded cost.

## Suggested Fix
1. Add `verifyAdminClaim(context)` helper checking custom claims
2. Use `req.headers['x-forwarded-for']` or Cloud Run `X-Cloud-Trace-Context`
3. Validate URL scheme (https only) + block private IP ranges
4. Add per-user daily call counter in Firestore
5-9. Add express-validator middleware with field length limits

tickets.title: Fix Cloud Functions: idempotency failures, OOM cleanup, N+1 queries, wrong timeout config (9 issues)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. Non-idempotent onCreate triggers
`functions/src/triggers/onRecipeCreate.ts`, `onUserCreate.ts` â€” Cloud Functions can retry on timeout. These create denormalized docs without checking if they already exist â†’ duplicate data on retry.

### 2. cleanupOrphanedData fetches all docs into memory
`functions/src/admin/cleanupOrphanedData.ts` â€” `const allRecipes = await db.collection('recipes').get()` loads entire collection. Will OOM at ~10k recipes.

### 3. N+1 query in generateWeeklyDigest
`functions/src/scheduled/weeklyDigest.ts` â€” loops users, fetches recipes one-by-one inside loop instead of batch query.

### 4. Wrong timeout/memory on v2 functions
3 functions set `timeoutSeconds: 60` (v1 syntax) in v2 `onCall` options â€” silently ignored, gets default 60s which may be too short for batch operations.

### 5-9. Error handling gaps
5 functions catch errors but return `{success: true}` anyway, 2 functions don't catch at all (unhandled rejection â†’ cold start on next call).

## Why It Matters
Non-idempotent triggers cause duplicate data. OOM crashes cleanup function. N+1 causes weekly digest timeout.

## Suggested Fix
1. Check document existence before create in triggers
2. Use paginated query with `startAfter` cursor
3. Batch user recipe queries with `where('userId', 'in', chunk)`
4. Use `timeoutSeconds` in `GlobalOptions` or per-function `HttpsOptions`
5-9. Return error status on catch, add try-catch to unguarded functions

tickets.title: Fix CRITICAL: Firestore rules missing for camelCase denorm collections + 8 more collections (menu/shopping sharing broken)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. Denormalized collections use camelCase, rules use snake_case
`firestore.rules` has rules for `shared_recipes`, `shared_menus`, `shared_shopping_lists` but app code writes to `sharedRecipes`, `sharedMenus`, `sharedShoppingLists`. Rules never match â†’ default deny â†’ all sharing silently fails.

### 2. 8 collections with no rules at all
- `userPresence` â€” presence writes blocked
- `recipeEngagements` â€” likes/comments blocked
- `menuTemplates` â€” menu template CRUD blocked
- `shoppingListItems` (subcollection) â€” item add/remove blocked
- `friendCategories` â€” category management blocked
- `groupInvitations` â€” group invite flow blocked
- `userNotificationPreferences` â€” notification prefs blocked
- `recipeImportQueue` â€” import queue blocked

### 3. Collection naming inconsistency
Mix of camelCase (`userPresence`) and snake_case (`user_profiles`) across codebase. No naming convention enforced.

## Why It Matters
CRITICAL: All social sharing features (recipes, menus, shopping lists) are silently broken in production. Firestore default-deny means writes succeed client-side (optimistic) but fail server-side.

## Suggested Fix
1. Add rules for camelCase collection names matching app code
2. Add rules for all 8 missing collections with proper auth checks
3. Document naming convention, migrate to consistent style in next major version

tickets.title: Fix Firestore rule logic bugs: menu reads permanently denied, reactions blocked, ownership hijack (7 issues)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. Menu read rule permanently denies after unshare
`firestore.rules:847` â€” `resource.data.sharedWith` checked but field removed on unshare instead of set to empty array. `resource.data.sharedWith` â†’ field doesn't exist â†’ rule throws â†’ deny. Owner also locked out.

### 2. Reactions subcollection create blocked
`firestore.rules:923` â€” requires `request.resource.data.userId == request.auth.uid` but client sends `authorId` field instead.

### 3. Recipe ownership hijack via update
`firestore.rules:312` â€” update rule checks `request.auth.uid == resource.data.userId` but doesn't prevent changing `userId` field. User can transfer ownership to themselves for any recipe they can update.

### 4. Comment delete allows any participant
`firestore.rules:945` â€” delete rule checks group membership but not comment authorship. Any group member can delete anyone's comments.

### 5-7. Minor logic issues
5. `get()` in rules counts toward quota but result uncached across rule evaluations
6. `hasAll` used where `hasAny` intended for permission check
7. Timestamp validation allows future dates (no `<= request.time` check)

## Why It Matters
Finding 1: Menus permanently inaccessible after unshare. Finding 3: Any collaborator can steal recipe ownership.

## Suggested Fix
1. Check `'sharedWith' in resource.data && request.auth.uid in resource.data.sharedWith` with existence guard
2. Change field name to `authorId` in rule or `userId` in client
3. Add `!('userId' in request.resource.data) || request.resource.data.userId == resource.data.userId` to prevent ownership change
4. Add `resource.data.authorId == request.auth.uid || isOwner()` to comment delete
5-7. Cache get() results, fix hasAllâ†’hasAny, add timestamp bounds

tickets.title: Fix app lifecycle: deep link dropped on cold start, FCM navigation unwired, auth token expiry swallowed (3 critical bugs)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. Deep link dropped on cold start
`lib/services/deep_link_service.dart:45â€“67` â€” `getInitialLink()` called in `initialize()` but result stored before `NavigatorState` is available. Link processed, `_pendingDeepLink` set, but no widget is listening yet. After widget tree builds and subscribes, pending link already consumed.

### 2. FCM notification tap navigation unwired
`lib/services/notification/fcm_service.dart:89â€“112` â€” `onMessageOpenedApp` handler parses payload and calls `_handleNotificationTap()` which is a stub that only logs. User taps notification â†’ app opens to home screen, not the relevant content.

### 3. Auth token expiry swallowed
`lib/services/auth/auth_service.dart:234â€“241` â€” `onIdTokenChanged` catches `FirebaseAuthException` for expired token but only logs warning. No force-refresh attempted, no user redirect to login. User sees stale data until app restart.

## Why It Matters
Deep links from shared recipes/menus don't work on cold start (most common case). Notification taps don't navigate. Expired auth tokens cause silent data staleness.

## Suggested Fix
1. Queue pending deep link, process after first frame via `WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback`
2. Implement `_handleNotificationTap()` with route resolution from payload type
3. Call `user.getIdToken(true)` on expiry, redirect to login on failure

tickets.title: Fix app lifecycle: auto-save lost on background kill, presence ghost, offline sync race, FCM stub (4 issues)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. Auto-save lost on background kill
`lib/viewmodels/recipe_form_viewmodel.dart:89â€“95` â€” dirty form state only saved on explicit save button. `AppLifecycleState.paused` handler missing. OS kills backgrounded app â†’ unsaved edits lost.

### 2. Presence ghost after app kill
`lib/services/presence_service.dart:156â€“170` â€” `onDisconnect()` handler set on Firebase RTDB but only for graceful disconnect. Force-kill leaves presence as 'online' indefinitely. No server-side TTL.

### 3. Offline sync race on reconnect
`lib/services/unified/modules/personal_recipe_module.dart:612â€“640` â€” `_pendingWrites` queue replayed on connectivity change, but no ordering guarantee. If user edited recipe A then B offline, B might sync before A, and A's sync overwrites B's `lastModified`.

### 4. FCM token refresh stub
`lib/services/notification/fcm_service.dart:134â€“138` â€” `onTokenRefresh` stream listened but handler is `TODO: implement`. Old token becomes invalid, push notifications stop until app reinstall.

## Why It Matters
Auto-save loss frustrates users. Ghost presence misleads collaborators. Token refresh stub breaks push after token rotation.

## Suggested Fix
1. Add `WidgetsBindingObserver` + save dirty state on `paused`/`detached`
2. Add server-side presence TTL (Cloud Function cron: mark offline if no heartbeat in 5min)
3. Add sequence number to pending writes, replay in order
4. Implement token refresh: call `updateFCMToken(newToken)` on repository

tickets.title: Fix iOS critical misconfigs: wrong bundle ID in Firebase config, deployment target 13.0, https URL scheme, missing entitlements (5 issues)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. GoogleService-Info.plist bundle ID mismatch
`ios/Runner/GoogleService-Info.plist:BUNDLE_ID` = `com.example.butlery` but `ios/Runner.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj:PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER` = `com.butlery.app`. Firebase SDK will fail to initialize on real iOS device.

### 2. iOS deployment target 13.0
`ios/Podfile:platform :ios, '13.0'` â€” Firebase iOS SDK 11.x requires iOS 15.0+. Pod install will fail or produce runtime crashes.

### 3. URL scheme uses https
`ios/Runner/Info.plist:CFBundleURLSchemes` includes `https` â€” this is reserved by the system. Should use custom scheme like `butlery://`.

### 4. Missing Associated Domains entitlement
No `Runner.entitlements` file with `applinks:` domain. Universal links (deep links) won't work on iOS.

### 5. Missing push notification entitlement
No `aps-environment` in entitlements. FCM push notifications will silently fail on iOS.

## Why It Matters
Bundle ID mismatch = Firebase crash on launch = app unusable on iOS. Deployment target too low = pod install failure.

## Suggested Fix
1. Update GoogleService-Info.plist BUNDLE_ID to `com.butlery.app`
2. Update Podfile to `platform :ios, '15.0'`
3. Replace `https` URL scheme with `butlery`
4. Add `Runner.entitlements` with `applinks:butlery.app`
5. Add `aps-environment` = `production` to entitlements

tickets.title: Fix platform config: Cloud Functions region mismatch (NOT_FOUND), missing security headers, storage permission (4 issues)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. Cloud Functions region mismatch
`lib/services/cloud_functions_service.dart:15` â€” `FirebaseFunctions.instanceFor(region: 'us-central1')` but `functions/src/index.ts` deploys to `europe-west1`. All callable function invocations return NOT_FOUND.

### 2. Missing web security headers
`web/index.html` â€” no Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, or X-Content-Type-Options headers. App embeddable in iframe (clickjacking).

### 3. Android storage permission for image upload
`android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml` â€” missing `READ_MEDIA_IMAGES` permission (Android 13+). Image picker will fail silently on newer devices.

### 4. Firebase Storage CORS not configured
No `cors.json` deployed to Firebase Storage bucket. Web uploads may fail with CORS errors.

## Why It Matters
Region mismatch means ALL Cloud Function calls fail in production (NOT_FOUND). Missing storage permission breaks image upload on Android 13+.

## Suggested Fix
1. Change region to `europe-west1` in `cloud_functions_service.dart`
2. Add security headers via Firebase Hosting `firebase.json` headers config
3. Add `READ_MEDIA_IMAGES` + `READ_MEDIA_VIDEO` permissions
4. Deploy `cors.json` with allowed origins to Firebase Storage

tickets.title: Fix recipe parsing: no HTTP response size limit (OOM), no charset detection, JSON-LD @type array missed, instructions discarded (6 issues)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. No HTTP response size limit
`lib/services/import/url_import_strategy.dart:78â€“92` â€” `http.get(url)` reads entire response into memory. Malicious or misconfigured URL serving 500MB file â†’ OOM crash.

### 2. No charset detection
`lib/services/import/url_import_strategy.dart:95` â€” `response.body` assumes UTF-8 but many recipe sites use ISO-8859-1 or Windows-1252. Swedish characters (Ã¥, Ã¤, Ã¶) corrupted on import from older sites.

### 3. JSON-LD @type as array missed
`lib/services/parsing/recipe_parser_service.dart:234â€“240` â€” checks `jsonLd['@type'] == 'Recipe'` but Schema.org allows `@type: ['Recipe', 'HowTo']`. Array form silently skipped â†’ falls back to less accurate HTML scraping.

### 4. HowToSection instructions discarded
`lib/services/parsing/recipe_parser_service.dart:312â€“330` â€” `recipeInstructions` handler processes `HowToStep` but ignores `HowToSection` wrapper. Grouped instructions (e.g., 'For the dough:', 'For the filling:') lose all steps inside sections.

### 5. Yield field parsing ignores servings format
`lib/services/parsing/recipe_parser_service.dart:198` â€” `recipeYield: '4-6 servings'` parsed as string, not extracted to numeric range.

### 6. Duration parsing breaks on non-ISO format
`lib/services/parsing/recipe_parser_service.dart:205` â€” expects ISO 8601 (`PT30M`) but some sites use `30 min` or `30 minutes`. Parse fails silently â†’ null cook time.

## Why It Matters
OOM from unbounded response is a DoS vector. Charset corruption affects all Swedish recipe sites using legacy encoding.

## Suggested Fix
1. Use `http.Client` with `StreamedResponse` + max bytes check (10MB limit)
2. Read `Content-Type` charset header, use `dart:convert` Encoding.getByName
3. Check `jsonLd['@type'] is List ? jsonLd['@type'].contains('Recipe') : jsonLd['@type'] == 'Recipe'`

tickets.title: Fix DI lifecycle: cross-module dependency order bugs (StateError at bootstrap) + singleton streams not reset on logout (8 issues)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. Cross-module dependency order not enforced
`lib/di/` modules declare `priority` but 3 modules have equal priority with cross-dependencies. `SocialModule` (priority 30) depends on `UnifiedRecipeService` from `RecipeModule` (priority 30). Registration order within same priority is insertion order â†’ works by accident. Adding a new module at priority 30 can break bootstrap.

### 2. Circular dependency: NotificationService â†” FriendsService
`NotificationService` constructor takes `FriendsService` for friend-request notifications. `FriendsService` constructor takes `NotificationService` for sending notifications. Both registered in `SocialModule` â†’ one must be registered first â†’ the other's dependency is null at construction.

### 3. Singleton streams not reset on logout
`UnifiedRecipeService`, `PresenceService`, `IntelligentCacheManager` â€” registered as singletons in DI. On logout, `_recipes` map and stream subscriptions retained. On re-login as different user, previous user's data visible briefly.

### 4. dispose() never called on DI singletons
`lib/di/di_container.dart:reset()` calls `GetIt.instance.reset()` but doesn't call `dispose()` on ChangeNotifier singletons first. StreamControllers and listeners leak.

### 5-8. Registration gaps
5. `AnalyticsService` registered but depends on unregistered `ConsentManager`
6. `ImageUploadService` registered in `MediaModule` but `StorageRepository` in `FirebaseModule` â€” no declared dependency
7. Two `RecipeRepository` registrations (one in `FirebaseModule`, one in `RecipeModule`) â€” last wins silently
8. `TaggingService` registered as factory but used as singleton by callers caching the instance

## Why It Matters
Finding 1: Bootstrap crash on innocent module addition. Finding 3: Cross-user data leakage on logout/re-login. Finding 4: Resource leaks accumulate across auth cycles.

## Suggested Fix
1. Enforce dependency ordering: modules declare `dependsOn: [ModuleName]`, DI container topologically sorts
2. Break circular dep with lazy initialization or event bus
3. Add `resetUserState()` method to stateful singletons, call on logout
4. Call `dispose()` on all ChangeNotifier singletons before `reset()`
5-8. Audit and fix registration: remove duplicate, declare dependencies, convert TaggingService to singleton

tickets.title: Fix search infrastructure: debounce Completer leak, static mixin state, watchRecipes 50-doc cap (4 critical bugs)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. executeDebounced leaks Completer futures on rapid keypresses
`lib/core/mixins/async_operation_mixin.dart:133â€“159`

Each call creates a new `Completer<T?>`, then cancels the previous timer. Cancelled Completers are never completed â€” they leak, awaiting forever. `RecipeQueryViewModel.updateSearchQuery` (line 104) `await`s this. 10 rapid keypresses = 9 permanently abandoned Completers holding references.

### 2. watchRecipes stream silently truncates to 50 recipes
`lib/repositories/firebase/firebase_recipe_repository.dart:352â€“360`

The live stream feeding `UnifiedRecipeService.recipes` has `.limit(50)` ordered by `updatedAt desc`. Users with 51+ recipes never see older ones in any filter/search/sort. UI pagination operates on the already-truncated list.

### 3. Static _executionTimes is process-global â€” leaks across instances and auth sessions
`lib/core/mixins/async_operation_mixin.dart:360â€“368`

`static final Map<String, DateTime> _executionTimes` shared across ALL mixin instances. Never cleared on logout. Throttle timestamps from one user persist into next session, silently suppressing operations.

### 4. Debounce does not cancel in-flight async operation
`lib/core/mixins/async_operation_mixin.dart:46â€“60`

`executeDebounced` cancels the pending timer, but if a search is already executing inside `executeNamedOperation`, the next debounced search hits `_activeOperations.contains('recipeSearch')` and throws `StateError`. User sees no results update.

## Why It Matters
Finding 1: Memory leak and hung awaits. Finding 2: Users with 51+ recipes have silently incomplete search/filter results. Finding 3: Cross-user state leakage.

## Suggested Fix
1. Complete old Completer with `null` before replacing it
2. Remove `.limit(50)` from `watchRecipes`; use cursor-based pagination
3. Change `_executionTimes` from `static final` to instance field; clear in `dispose()`
4. Pass `allowConcurrent: true` or cancel in-flight operations properly

tickets.title: Fix search quality: Algolia empty owner, Firestore fallback unscoped, filter state leak on logout, date range off-by-one (13 issues)

tickets.title: Fix CRITICAL social group security: any member can hijack ownership, validateReadPermission always true, members can overwrite all fields (6 issues)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. Any group member can transfer ownership â€” no server-side guard
`lib/viewmodels/social_group_detail_viewmodel.dart:302â€“334` + `firestore.rules:205â€“208`

Firestore update rule allows any member listed in `friendUserIds` to update ANY field including `ownerId`. Client-side `isAdmin` check is bypassable. Any group member can transfer ownership to themselves or anyone.

### 2. validateReadPermission returns true for all group-shared content
`lib/repositories/firebase/firebase_social_sharing_repository.dart:107â€“110`

Comment says 'delegate to group-level security' but just returns `true`. Any authenticated user with a document ID can read group-shared content without being a member.

### 3. All four validate*Permission methods return true unconditionally
`lib/repositories/firebase/friends/friend_category_repository.dart:115â€“144`

All CRUD permissions bypass. Callers using generic `create()`/`delete()` base class methods have zero permission checks.

### 4. SharingPermissions.canEdit stored but never enforced
`lib/models/shared_content.dart:183â€“289` + `firestore.rules:346â€“351`

Firestore update rule for shared_recipes allows members to update non-ownership fields regardless of `allowCollaboration` flag.

### 5. addMember has no ownership check at Dart layer
`lib/repositories/firebase/base_shared_content_repository.dart:340â€“374`

Any caller can add any user as member of any content. Only Firestore rules enforce ownership.

### 6. Members can do full document set() overwriting all group fields
`lib/repositories/firebase/friends/friend_category_repository.dart:147â€“179`

`saveCategory` uses `.set(category.toFirestore())` â€” full overwrite including `ownerId`, `name`, `friendUserIds`. Any member can rename group, remove others, or set themselves as owner.

## Why It Matters
Finding 1+6: Any group member can steal ownership. Finding 2: Group content visible to non-members. Finding 4: Edit permissions meaningless.

## Suggested Fix
1. Add Firestore rule: only current owner can change `ownerId`
2. Implement actual group membership check before returning true
3. Implement real ownership checks in validate* methods
4. Add `resource.data.allowCollaboration == true` to member update rule
5. Fetch content doc and verify ownership before addMember
6. Use targeted `.update()` for non-owner members; restrict to `friendUserIds` and `updatedAt` only

tickets.title: Fix social group flow: acceptInvitation doesn't add member, cancel blocked, remove stub empty, rules mismatch (10 issues)

Findings 1-3: Group invitation, acceptance, and removal flows are all broken. Finding 5: shared_content collection is inaccessible.

tickets.title: Fix image pipeline: wrong Storage paths bypass security, web uploads crash on blob URL and missing compression (5 critical issues)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. Avatar upload uses wrong Storage path â€” bypasses security rules
`lib/viewmodels/user_profile_viewmodel.dart:150`

Uploads to `avatars/$userId/...` but security rules only allow `users/$userId/...`. Permission validation at `firebase_storage_repository.dart:96` rejects the path. All avatar uploads fail.

### 2. Recipe images uploaded to wrong path â€” bypasses security
`lib/viewmodels/recipe_form/recipe_image_manager.dart:466,894,1000` + `xfile_upload_handler.dart:174`

Multiple upload calls use `recipes/$recipeId/...` instead of `users/$userId/recipes/...`. Same security rule violation.

### 3. File(blob URL) on web always crashes
`lib/viewmodels/recipe_form/recipe_image_manager.dart:888` + `xfile_upload_handler.dart:168` + `image_picker_service.dart:153`

On web, `xFile.path` is a `blob:http://...` URL. `File(xFile.path)` creates a dart:io File that doesn't exist on web. Any `.readAsBytes()` throws.

### 4. flutter_image_compress not supported on web â€” all file uploads fail
`lib/repositories/firebase/firebase_storage_repository.dart:410â€“474`

`compressImage()` throws `MissingPluginException` on web. Catch returns `null`. `uploadImage()` then throws 'Failed to compress image'. Recipe image uploads on web are completely broken.

### 5. uploadImageBytes has no compression â€” full-size bytes uploaded
`lib/services/storage_service.dart:85â€“118`

Passes bytes directly to repository without compression. Web avatar uploads get full-resolution images.

## Why It Matters
Findings 1-2: Avatar and recipe image uploads fail with PermissionDeniedException (or bypass security if validation is skipped). Findings 3-4: ALL image operations on web are broken.

## Suggested Fix
1-2. Fix paths to `users/$userId/avatars/...` and `users/$userId/recipes/...`
3. On web, use `xFile.readAsBytes()` directly; never construct dart:io File
4. Add `kIsWeb` check; skip compression on web or use web-compatible library

tickets.title: Fix image display & cleanup: orphaned images on delete, fake CDN params, fullscreen OOM, double compression (10 issues)

`lib/repositories/firebase/firebase_storage_repository.dart:499â€“501`

`lib/services/account/account_deletion/storage_deletion_operations.dart:59â€“67`

## Why It Matters
Finding 1: Unbounded Storage cost growth. Finding 2: Image loading may break. Finding 3: OOM on image carousel.

tickets.title: Fix auth security: registration without email verification, rate limiter bypassable, user enumeration via error messages (5 critical issues)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. Registration allows full app access without email verification
`lib/services/auth_service.dart:51â€“96`

`registerWithEmail()` creates Firebase account and returns `true` immediately. No `sendEmailVerification()`, no `emailVerified` check, no gate screen. Users can register with any email (including others') and gain full access.

### 2. Rate limiter bypassable via app restart â€” unlimited login retries
`lib/services/auth_service.dart:87â€“95`

Client-side `_rateLimiter` is in-memory only, not persisted. Killing and relaunching the app resets all token buckets. `RateLimitException` is also caught by generic `catch(e)` and swallowed.

### 3. User enumeration via distinct error messages
`lib/services/auth_service.dart:545â€“549`

`user-not-found` â†’ 'No user found' vs `wrong-password` â†’ 'Wrong password'. Different messages reveal whether an email has an account.

### 4. Password reset not rate-limited server-side
`lib/repositories/firebase/firebase_auth_repository.dart:179â€“187`

Client-side limiter (3 tokens, 1/hour refill) resets on restart. Attacker can spam reset emails to any address.

### 5. Password reset confirms email existence
`lib/services/auth_service.dart:205â€“217`

`user-not-found` error propagated to UI reveals whether address has account. Should always show 'if that email exists, a reset link was sent'.

## Why It Matters
Finding 1: Account squatting, phishing enabled. Finding 2: Credential stuffing unmitigated. Findings 3+5: Account enumeration.

## Suggested Fix
1. Send verification email after registration; add gate screen checking emailVerified
2. Add explicit `on RateLimitException` handler; persist bucket to SharedPreferences; add server-side rate limiting
3. Merge user-not-found and wrong-password to same message
4. Use Firebase App Check + server-side email limits
5. Always show generic success message on reset

User can import a recipe and close the app without 'SlutfÃ¶r' being called. Onboarding not marked complete.

### 8. Deep link processed during onboarding
`lib/main.dart:720â€“726`

No check for `hasCompletedOnboarding` before processing deep link. Navigation pushed on top of onboarding.

### 9. registerWithEmail doesn't create Firestore profile
`lib/services/auth_service.dart:51â€“96`

Profile creation is async side-effect of auth stream. Window between auth creation and profile exists.

### 10. New profile doesn't set hasCompletedOnboarding explicitly
`lib/services/user_service.dart:120â€“134` â€” relies on model default.

### 11. PageView allows unrestricted swiping past boundaries
`lib/views/onboarding/onboarding_view.dart:62â€“70`

### 12. Skip button visible on last page â€” confusing UX
`lib/views/onboarding/onboarding_view.dart:81â€“106`

## Why It Matters
Findings 1-5: Onboarding flow has multiple bypass paths â€” new users can reach main app without completing setup. Finding 6: iOS notification permission wasted.

## Suggested Fix
1. Merge allergen save + onboarding flag into single Firestore update
2. Rethrow or return bool from markOnboardingComplete

4. Show loading spinner when profile is null
5. Remove imperative navigation; trust AuthWrapper
6. Defer FCM permission to post-onboarding
7. Mark onboarding complete before navigating to import
8. Check hasCompletedOnboarding before processing deep links
9. Create profile atomically in registration flow

tickets.title: Rework social system: reduce 14 Firestore collections to 3, eliminate 35K+ lines of scaffolding

tickets.title: Rework DI container: add user-session scope to fix cross-user cache leaks and singleton lifecycle bugs

tickets.title: Fix silent ingredient mutation: preprocessing runs on every keystroke instead of save-time
tickets.description:
## Finding
In recipe_backward_compatibility_mixin.dart:131-138, updateIngredient() runs IngredientProcessor.preprocessOnly(value) on every keystroke. This pipeline (ingredient_preprocessor.dart:68-79) lowercases, normalizes ranges to max value ('2-3 dl' -> '3 dl'), strips approximations ('ca 3 dl' -> '3 dl'), and removes parenthetical notes ('2 dl mjolk (helmjolk)' -> '2 dl mjolk').

The TextEditingController holds raw text, but state.ingredientsManager stores the cleaned version. Draft auto-save serializes cleaned values, so restored drafts permanently lose parenthetical notes and approximations.

## Why It Matters
Users who type 'ca 3-5 dl gradde (vispgradde)' will have their text silently transformed. The loss of clarifications is permanent once draft is saved.

## Suggested Fix
Remove preprocessing from updateIngredient(). Apply only at persist time in RecipeFormState.createRecipe(). No UI changes needed.

tickets.title: Fix accessibility semantic labels: English on RecipeCard, missing on rating pill, typo in SyncIndicator

tickets.title: Fix offline UX: sync result discarded, connectivity check hardcoded true, no offline banner

tickets.title: Fix menu-to-shopping naive ingredient dedup and add auto-tags to Algolia search index

tickets.title: Improve developer experience: wire very_good_analysis, activate kill switches, fix dynamic types, split test mocks
